_readme: Six additional synthetic Week 1 SOC log-analysis cases (TC-08 through TC-13). Standalone supplement ONLY: it does not replace Testing/Test-Cases.json and is not automatically read by the existing benchmark.py. To benchmark these cases, back up Testing/Test-Cases.json and append the six objects in this file's cases array to its cases array, without modifying TC-01..TC-07. All IP addresses are private or documentation-only (RFC 5737); all hostnames are fictional. Ground truth and keyword checks are evaluation aids; manual analyst review is required.

cases.title: Nginx WAF blocks repeated SQL injection probes (blocked, no compromise proven)
input_lines: 2026-10-14T11:30:01Z waf01 WAF action=BLOCK rule_id=942100 category=SQLi src_ip=203.0.113.61 dst_host=shop.example uri="/products?id=1%27%20OR%201%3D1--" http_status=403 request_id=WAF-8801
2026-10-14T11:30:03Z web01 nginx access src_ip=203.0.113.61 method=GET uri="/products?id=1%27%20OR%201%3D1--" status=403 upstream_status=- request_id=WAF-8801
2026-10-14T11:30:06Z waf01 WAF action=BLOCK rule_id=942100 category=SQLi src_ip=203.0.113.61 dst_host=shop.example uri="/products?id=1%20UNION%20SELECT%20NULL" http_status=403 request_id=WAF-8802
2026-10-14T11:30:07Z web01 nginx access src_ip=203.0.113.61 method=GET uri="/products?id=1%20UNION%20SELECT%20NULL" status=403 upstream_status=- request_id=WAF-8802
2026-10-14T11:30:15Z web01 nginx access src_ip=198.51.100.10 method=GET uri="/health" status=200 upstream_status=200 request_id=HEALTH-102
2026-10-14T11:31:00Z waf01 WAF summary src_ip=203.0.113.61 blocked_requests=2 allowed_requests=0 observation_window=60s
cases.ground_truth: Two SQL injection-pattern requests from 203.0.113.61 were blocked by WAF rule 942100 and logged as HTTP 403 with no upstream response; unrelated /health GET from another IP succeeded. The provided data do not demonstrate exploitation, data theft, or compromise. Analyst may recommend reviewing WAF coverage and searching for other requests.

expected_findings.description: Correctly notices block decision and HTTP 403

cases.title: Windows endpoint suspicious LSASS access attempt prevented by EDR
input_lines: 2026-10-14T13:01:07Z WS-HR-04 Sysmon EventID=1 ProcessGuid={aa11-bb22} Image=C:\Users\Public\helper.exe CommandLine="C:\Users\Public\helper.exe" User=CORP\jlee ParentImage=C:\Windows\explorer.exe
2026-10-14T13:01:12Z WS-HR-04 Sysmon EventID=10 SourceImage=C:\Users\Public\helper.exe TargetImage=C:\Windows\System32\lsass.exe GrantedAccess=0x1fffff SourceProcessGUID={aa11-bb22}
2026-10-14T13:01:12Z WS-HR-04 EDR alert=CredentialAccessAttempt severity=High process=C:\Users\Public\helper.exe target=lsass.exe action=BLOCK outcome=Prevented alert_id=EDR-4419
2026-10-14T13:01:13Z WS-HR-04 EDR alert_id=EDR-4419 process_terminated=true file_quarantined=true
2026-10-14T13:02:20Z WS-HR-04 Security EventID=4624 Account=jlee LogonType=2 result=Success
cases.ground_truth: The process helper.exe attempted high-privilege access to lsass.exe, triggering an EDR prevention event; EDR indicates it blocked the attempt, terminated and quarantined the process. Logon type 2 for user jlee afterward is recorded but is not evidence that credentials were stolen. Neither an LSASS dump nor exfiltration is shown.

cases.title: DNS long-label query burst suggesting possible tunneling (insufficient proof)
input_lines: 2026-10-14T14:22:00Z dns01 query client=10.30.4.19 qname=ab8f93cd7721e4011f09.sync-data.example qtype=TXT rcode=NOERROR answers=1
2026-10-14T14:22:02Z dns01 query client=10.30.4.19 qname=aa17ef1098dbd778f1a2.sync-data.example qtype=TXT rcode=NOERROR answers=1
2026-10-14T14:22:04Z dns01 query client=10.30.4.19 qname=c9fdab0a2ef2140de1ca.sync-data.example qtype=TXT rcode=NOERROR answers=1
2026-10-14T14:22:06Z dns01 query client=10.30.4.19 qname=7f81aedc5b829a121eaa.sync-data.example qtype=TXT rcode=NOERROR answers=1
2026-10-14T14:22:09Z dns01 query client=10.30.4.19 qname=1e50aef2bd51af9012ab.sync-data.example qtype=TXT rcode=NOERROR answers=1
2026-10-14T14:22:11Z dns01 query client=10.30.4.19 qname=c2e950ffaa221cdc0188.sync-data.example qtype=TXT rcode=NOERROR answers=1
2026-10-14T14:22:12Z dns01 summary client=10.30.4.19 qtype=TXT qname_suffix=sync-data.example count=6 time_window_s=12
cases.ground_truth: Six TXT queries from internal host 10.30.4.19 to unique, high-entropy-looking subdomains under sync-data.example over 12 seconds. This could warrant investigation for DNS tunneling, but six queries do not prove tunneling or data exfiltration. There is no payload inspection or destination ownership information.

cases.title: AWS CloudTrail console login followed by privileged group and access key changes
input_lines: 2026-10-14T15:10:01Z cloudtrail eventName=ConsoleLogin userIdentity.userName=ops-temp sourceIPAddress=203.0.113.90 additionalEventData.MFAUsed=No responseElements.ConsoleLogin=Success awsRegion=us-east-1

2026-10-14T15:11:45Z cloudtrail eventName=AddUserToGroup userIdentity.userName=ops-temp sourceIPAddress=203.0.113.90 requestParameters.userName=ops-temp requestParameters.groupName=SecurityAdmins response=Success
2026-10-14T15:12:03Z cloudtrail eventName=CreateAccessKey userIdentity.userName=ops-temp sourceIPAddress=203.0.113.90 requestParameters.userName=ops-temp response=Success
2026-10-14T15:12:21Z cloudtrail eventName=ListBuckets userIdentity.userName=ops-temp sourceIPAddress=203.0.113.90 response=Success
2026-10-14T15:13:10Z cloudtrail context change_ticket=NotProvided account_owner_confirmation=NotProvided known_source_ip=NotProvided
cases.ground_truth: Successful no-MFA ConsoleLogin for ops-temp from 203.0.113.90, followed by adding that user to SecurityAdmins and creating an access key; bucket listing followed. This is high-risk privilege and credential activity requiring urgent authorization check. No evidence in logs of confirmed compromise or data transfer. Neither account owner nor change ticket is provided.

expected_findings.description: Requests authorization validation, not automatic compromise attribution

cases.title: Multiple off-hours RDP logons from jump host to two internal servers
input_lines: 2026-10-14 02:10:10 FS01 Security EventID=4624 Account=CORP\svc_ops LogonType=10 SourceIP=10.10.5.20 WorkstationName=JUMP-02
2026-10-14 02:10:45 FS01 Security EventID=4672 Account=CORP\svc_ops Privileges=SeDebugPrivilege,SeBackupPrivilege
2026-10-14 02:13:22 APP01 Security EventID=4624 Account=CORP\svc_ops LogonType=10 SourceIP=10.10.5.20 WorkstationName=JUMP-02
2026-10-14 02:13:31 APP01 Security EventID=4672 Account=CORP\svc_ops Privileges=SeDebugPrivilege,SeBackupPrivilege
2026-10-14 02:15:00 cmdb asset=JUMP-02 ip=10.10.5.20 role=approved_admin_jump_host
2026-10-14 02:15:01 access_policy account=CORP\svc_ops permitted_hosts=FS01,APP01 standard_window=09:00-17:00 change_exception=NotProvided
cases.ground_truth: Two successful RemoteInteractive (LogonType 10) logons using svc_ops from a known, approved jump host to two permitted servers, both outside the standard time window. Privileged logon events follow. This merits verification of an approved exception but is not sufficient to label lateral movement or account compromise as confirmed.

expected_findings.description: Accounts for approved jump host / authorized path

cases.title: Benign approved Windows maintenance and patch deployment (false-positive trap)
input_lines: 2026-10-14 02:00:00 change_mgmt ticket=CHG-2048 status=Approved host=APP02 operator=CORP\patchsvc window=02:00-03:00 purpose=monthly_patch_deployment
2026-10-14 02:03:14 APP02 Security EventID=4624 Account=CORP\patchsvc LogonType=3 SourceIP=10.20.4.12
2026-10-14 02:04:01 APP02 Sysmon EventID=1 Image=C:\Windows\System32\msiexec.exe ParentImage=C:\Program Files\CorpPatch\patchagent.exe User=CORP\patchsvc
2026-10-14 02:04:12 APP02 EDR FileExecution file=C:\Program Files\CorpPatch\update.msi signer=CorpPatch-IT SignatureValid=True disposition=Allowed
2026-10-14 02:09:20 APP02 PatchAgent ticket=CHG-2048 packages_installed=3 result=Success reboot_required=False
2026-10-14 02:10:05 APP02 ServiceControlManager EventID=7036 ServiceName=AppService new_state=Running
cases.ground_truth: Approved scheduled maintenance CHG-2048 by patchsvc within 02:00-03:00. MSI execution has an expected patch agent parent and valid signature; patch agent reports success and service running. No evidence of malicious activity; the analyst should not escalate solely because of msiexec or service changes.
